items.source: Return this method reference as a CodeBlock using the specified MethodReference.ArgumentCodeGenerator.
items.translation: 将此方法引用作为使用指定的MethodReference.ArgumentCodeGenerator的CodeBlock返回。

items.source: argumentCodeGenerator - the argument code generator to use
items.translation: argumentCodeGenerator - 要使用的参数代码生成器

items.source: a code block to invoke the method
items.translation: 一个用于调用该方法的代码块

items.source:
If the caller has an instance of the type in which this method is
defined, it can hint that by specifying the type as a target class.
items.translation: 如果调用方拥有此方法定义类型的实例，可以通过指定该类型为目标类来提示这一点。

items.source: Return this method reference as a CodeBlock. If the reference is to an instance method then this::<method name> will be returned.
items.translation: 将此方法引用返回为 `CodeBlock` 。如果该引用指向实例方法，则返回 `this::`。

items.source: Return this method reference as a CodeBlock.

A reference to a method with convenient code generation for
referencing, or invoking it.
items.translation: 对具有便捷代码生成功能以引用或调用它的方法的引用。

items.source: Strategy for generating code for arguments based on their type.
items.translation: 基于参数类型生成代码的策略。

items.source: a code block for the method reference.
